status: Scoped current-account persistence and cancellation qualified locally; overall production readiness remains active.
behavior: Keyring captures caller-independent selection, awaits real storage acknowledgement, then publishes and invokes State/caller effects. Ordinary failed writes leave the previous live/durable selection unchanged. Null clears are acknowledged; malformed saved records refuse without overwrite.

CurrentAccountStore serializes all application selection writes and retains the selection slot through compensation. Guarded mobile/metadata work validates request identity and prior selected object before and after storage. Cancellation or a newer choice suppresses provisional publication and restores the prior durable value before releasing the slot. Later explicit choices cannot be overwritten by an older repair.

Known-topic pairing cancellation waits for topic retirement, selection settlement and any pending repair. Failed compensation reports failure, publishes no current wallet, refreshes State context and clears Sora signing-pair references. Explicit cancellation retry attempts repair again. Successful pairing status is emitted synchronously with final acknowledged selection publication.

New mobile selections retain wcTopic. Restart refuses to publish a retired mobile selection and durably clears it; startup excludes retired mobile accounts from fallback choices. Startup validates selection revision/object across retirement reads and refreshes account catalog. Restore ignores reads superseded by explicit choices, while concurrent startup reads do not invalidate one another.

Metadata refresh selects only its exact current target and uses a guarded write so queued refresh cannot override an already pending user choice. All current selection callers and both startup entrypoints await acknowledgement. Selected-wallet State context updates separately from caller success during repair.

findings.description: State captured its account catalog before awaiting the retirement journal. A new imported and selected wallet could be absent from the stale catalog, allowing startup to replace the newer choice with an old fallback.
findings.disposition: Fixed by capturing current-account revision and object before the await, checking both afterward, and refreshing account catalog after the read. Actual onInstall and ensureCurrentAccount held-read regressions reproduce and cover the seam.

findings.description: Failed compensation initially published null only through Keyring, leaving State services and retained Sora signing pairs stale.
findings.disposition: Fixed with separate recovery-state callback into State context update for null and repaired prior selection, without invoking success callback. Both Sora pair references are explicitly cleared when selection has no local Substrate key; tests inspect actual @sora-substrate/util singleton.

findings.description: restoreCurrentAccount could publish an older stored snapshot over a newly requested selection during storage/retirement awaits.
findings.disposition: Request revision captured and checked before publication or retired-selection clear; held-read regression retained.

reviewConclusions: Selection queue retains ownership through compensating storage write and retries unresolved repair before admitting following selections. Later queued choices cannot be clobbered by an older compensation.

Guarded operation publishes synchronously only after storage acknowledgement and final context validation. Failed compensation clears runtime selection and context; cancellation does not acknowledge success before retirement and repair settle.
Startup excludes retired mobile accounts and persists wcTopic with new current-selection records. Exact-target metadata update avoids copying another wallet Ethereum mapping into the selected wallet.

Reviewed caller await propagation and actual Chrome harness scope: create/switch acknowledgements, independent metadata target, two restarts and retired fallback exclusion. Harness uses public unfunded identities and does not exercise relay negotiation.
limits: No claim that modeled Chrome adapter failures reproduce device/storage crash atomicity.
No actual relay/device session negotiation or cross-tab IndexedDB concurrency qualification by this review.
Compensation cannot prevent a submitted write from reaching durable storage; final publication is withheld and retirement prevents cancelled mobile selection from regaining authority after restart.
Full product selection UI, all locales/accessibility and unrelated signing/session gates remain separate.
Root must pin final full/build/real Chrome results and preserved fixture diagnostics before acceptance.

limits: A submitted storage write can become durable before context invalidation is observed. Publication is withheld; cancellation waits for repair. If storage keeps failing, cancellation fails and runtime selection is cleared. The in-process repair queue is not a generic crash journal; durable retirement prevents a cancelled known mobile topic from regaining session authority after restart.

Current selection is UI/runtime context, not the whole account/key transaction. Imported public records may remain after cancelled pairing. Account deletion, wallet reset/password partial failures and broader key lifecycle remain separate gates.

Unit tests model Chrome storage delay/errors and controlled SDK sessions; real Chrome covers normal acknowledged writes and clean worker reloads only. IndexedDB/cross-tab writes, physical disk failure/abrupt termination, actual relay/mobile/device interaction and external storage mutation remain unqualified.
No new all-locale/UI/assistive-technology acceptance is claimed. Existing Sora pair references are cleared/rebound; this does not qualify real Sora transactions or other retained service caches.
Historical upgrades, private-chain final-artifact sends, remaining presentation/authentication work, production archives, owner decisions and publication remain open.
